title: Paired downstream review of candidate platform hardening
problem: The candidate contains real watcher and asynchronous daemon fixes whose downstream review should be measured with an executed no-route baseline and an intent-aware route, not inferred from a task-board dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: A reviewer WorkItem is claimed and synchronized before its verification intent; the persisted baseline reports the route items actually delivered in that state.
The same reviewer, with an overlapping verification intent and no explicit WorkItem dependency, receives a persisted ImpactDetected route with explainable reasons.
An unrelated observer receives no routed item, and two bounded replays from the same cursor return identical route keys.
An independent reviewer workspace runs the real watcher and daemon suites; the exact exit code and test counts are recorded.
Coordination is controlled by a distinct, remotely qualified stable predecessor; the candidate daemon is not started and the candidate SHA is recorded.

evidencePlan.coordination: Persist source/reviewer/observer WorkItems, sessions, source and reviewer intents, baseline and intent-aware sync cursors, ImpactDetected reasons, replay keys, observer isolation, and completion events.
evidencePlan.evaluation: This review records a real downstream test outcome; it does not manufacture a rejection or claim a repair cycle that was not observed.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind the reviewer workspace HEAD, test command/output, candidate SHA, stable predecessor SHA, and remote check-run conclusions to the result.

observedEvidenceBoundary: This is an executed paired review of committed my-pi platform changes. It can contribute observed routing evidence, but it must not be promoted into a PN6 rework-improvement claim unless the run measures downstream rework against the executed baseline.
